recentItems.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Could Be Great, But There's Some Things We Can't Ignore...
recentItems.description:
Seeing Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis running live on a massive screen confirms one thing immediately: it is absurdly pretty. In a recent hands-off preview at Gamescom we got to see Legacy's revamped version of the infamous Damocles Room, a chamber of raining swords where classic instant-death traps have been transformed into fluid, towering traversal puzzles, and we got to appreciate how the staggering visual fidelity on offer breathes new life into an essential piece of gaming history, while getting to talk to Crystal Dynamics about their ambitious attempt to fold Lara Croft's disparate eras into a single unified timeline.

But smooshing three distinct eras of Tomb Raider into one broad continuity is a difficult task that makes for some questionable choices. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis gameplay grafts baffling survival mechanics onto a classic '90s adventure, while a composite of Laras leads to some dizzying tonal whiplash. And, the studio's controversial use of generative AI in development raises some eyebrows, leaving crucial pieces of in-game art looking very suspect. Is this the definitive Lara Croft remake, or are mistakes being made? As always on The Trinca Perspective, Jim is here to give you an honest rundown, warts n' all.

recentItems.title: NHL 27 Review
recentItems.description:
EA Sports NHL 27 reviewed by Marc Deschamps on Xbox Series X|S, also available on PlayStation 5.

"Hockey is one of the greatest sports in the world, and NHL 27 remains enjoyable largely due to that simple fact. The satisfaction of delivering a bone-crushing hit or snapping a wrist shot past a goaltender is just as effective as ever, and tiny tweaks to stuff like stadiums and music continue to add authenticity in small doses – but there are no illusions that anything truly substantial has changed this year. With franchises like NHL Hitz and NHL 2K long dead, there really aren’t any other options on the market. This lack of competition puts the hockey faithful in a difficult position, and doubly so since there weren’t many changes in NHL 26 compared to NHL 25 to begin with. The handful of differences here are mostly welcome, nothing is worse than last year, but very little is better either. It’s a shame that NHL 27 is still stuck in the past."

recentItems.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker - Early Game Skill Tree Guide | Best Early Skills
recentItems.description:
The skill trees in The Blood of Dawnwalker go way beyond the standard "get a point, buy a skill" system. Between managing valuable in-game time, hunting down specific skill manuals in the world, and raising your corruption levels by drinking blood, building out Coen's arsenal takes some strategy. In this video, we break down exactly how the Witchcraft, Swordmastery, and Vampirism trees work, how to equip your abilities, and give our top recommendations on the absolute best early skills to grab first.

Whether you prefer wielding a sword in the daylight or unleashing Coen's Vrakhiri vampire claws at night, optimizing your build early on is crucial. We dive into essential early-game abilities like Haste, Soul Reaping, Charge, and Voracious Bite, alongside vital perks that boost your armor, stamina, and activation charges. Knowing how to balance your weapon types and manage your health costs will give you a massive advantage against both standard enemies and tough bosses.

recentItems.title: Naughty Dog Has No Involvement in TLOU Season 3, But Teased More Games - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Naughty Dog's Neil Druckmann confirmed to The Washington Post that the game developer is not involved creatively with HBO's The Last of Us anymore. The company is still working on TLOU games, despite having its live-service title canceled. HBO's The Last of Us will be debuting its third and final season sometime in 2027. In other news, Nintendo has announced two Directs for next week: one focusing on The Legend of Zelda's 40th anniversary, and the other a showcase of titles coming to Switch 2 later this year. We're hoping the Zelda direct not only features the first gameplay of the Ocarina of Time remake, but also a footage from next year's Legend of Zelda movie. And finally we take a quick look at all the new games released this week.
